name: Pizzeria Pisa
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Pisa in Innsbruck**

Welcome to **Pizzeria Pisa** in the heart of **Innsbruck**, where authentic Italian flavors meet the charm of the **Tirol** Alps. Indulge in our freshly baked pizzas, crafted with the finest ingredients, and enjoy a cozy atmosphere perfect for a relaxed meal or a lively evening with friends.

Try our classic **Margherita**, a timeless favorite, or savor the rich **Diavola** with spicy salami. For something sweet, don’t miss our delicious **Tiramisu**—a perfect end to your meal.

Whether you're craving a quick bite or a full Italian feast, **Pizzeria Pisa** in **Innsbruck** delivers taste and warmth in every bite. Come and experience the magic of Italian cuisine in the heart of **Tirol**!
